verdict.rationale: Codex CLI docs explicitly describe exploring unfamiliar code and running local dev tools to investigate issues, passing error screenshots for context, delegating focused investigation to subagents, and running dedicated reviews against uncommitted changes/commits/base branches to verify fixes before committing — covering reproduce, narrow-down, and verify steps. Missing for 10: no explicit 'reproduce a bug' walkthrough or first-hand/independent account of successfully diagnosing and fixing a real bug end-to-end with Codex.
